name: Zeiss Planetarium Schwaz
kurzbeschreibung: The Zeiss Planetarium in Schwaz: Western Austria's most modern fulldome dome cinema with digital star simulations and captivating journeys into space.
beschreibung:
Overview

The Zeiss Planetarium Schwaz is conveniently located in the historic centre of the Silberstadt Schwaz in the Tyrolean Unterinntal at Alte Landstraße 15 at an altitude of approximately 545 metres. Nestled in the rich cultural landscape at the foot of the Kellerjoch, this star theatre, opened in 2001, is one of western Austria's most modern and popular educational institutions. Beneath an impressive eight-metre projection dome, the planetarium takes tens of thousands of astronomy enthusiasts, families, and school groups each year on spectacular, true-to-life voyages through our solar system to the outer edges of the observable universe.

Fulldome Technology & Starry Skies

At the heart of the planetarium is the high-precision opto-mechanical Zeiss star projector coupled with a state-of-the-art digital 4K fulldome projection system. This cutting-edge technology projects over 9,000 sparkling fixed stars onto the dome with peerless brilliance, recreating the night sky from any location on Earth, at any historical date, or into the distant future. Alongside live astronomical presentations where experienced astronomers explain current celestial events, planetary alignments, and constellations, the programme includes a diverse repertoire of gripping 360-degree science films. Topics range from the origin of our Moon and the search for extraterrestrial life to the mysteries of black holes and child-friendly animated adventure stories. The immersive dome experience is enhanced by a modern surround-sound system and an interactive foyer exhibition featuring authentic meteorite specimens, scaled spacecraft models, and antique telescopes.

Visit & Getting There

The Zeiss Planetarium Schwaz is open year-round from Tuesday to Sunday; shows take place several times daily from 14:00 on weekdays and from 10:00 on weekends and during school holidays (closed Mondays). Ticket prices (2025/2026 season): regular show adults approx. €11.00, seniors and students approx. €9.50, children and youths (aged 4 to 15) approx. €7.50, children under 4 free; family ticket approx. €29.00. Holders of the regional Silbercard receive a discount. Arriving by car: via the Inntalautobahn A12 (exit Vomp or Schwaz), follow signs toward the town centre and planetarium; paid parking is available in the adjacent Stadtgarage Schwaz. By public transport: ÖBB/S-Bahn train to Bahnhof Schwaz, followed by a leisurely seven-minute walk directly to the planetarium.

Tips

The dome auditorium and foyer are completely barrier-free and step-free accessible for wheelchairs; an inductive hearing loop system is provided for hearing-impaired guests. Because seating capacity under the dome is limited, advance online booking via the official website is strongly recommended, especially on weekends and rainy holiday days. Combine your visit with an excursion to the nearby Silberbergwerk Schwaz or Schloss Freundsberg.
